fields.name: a
fields.coerce: `max(0, parseInt(a) || 0)`, so a missing or non-numeric value is slot 0
fields.description: The first slot. If the two items stack, this slot gets the stack.

fields.name: b
fields.coerce: `max(0, parseInt(b) || 0)`, so a missing or non-numeric value is slot 0
fields.description: The second slot. If the two items stack, this slot becomes empty.

responses.name: Success
responses.when: All checks pass. If the two items can stack (`can_stack`: same stackable item, the same title unless G marks the title `stackable`, the same `data` for a `cxjar`, the same PvP flag, neither locked nor on a stand, and the total fits in one stack), slot `a` gets the sum and slot `b` becomes empty. Else, the two slots swap. A move to an empty slot is a swap.

rows.when: `a` and `b` are the same slot after the conversion.
The higher of the two slots is not below `isize` (42) and not below the length of `items`.
One of the two slots holds a placeholder (an upgrade or a compound runs on it).

also.summary: Your state with `reopen: true` and the two slots changed in `items`.
